terminal_action_boundary: Produce an internal KPI narrative without publishing it or modifying source systems

manifest.complete_content: Use only supplied exports, validate periods, produce an internal narrative, and perform no external action.

assumptions: Exports retain a stable documented shape
permissions_credentials_contract: Read operator-supplied exports only; no production credentials or write permissions
deterministic_controls: Reject missing sources and conflicting reporting periods before model analysis
prohibited_actions: Do not post externally or modify source systems
logging_audit_requirements: Record packet version, source names, reporting period, terminal status, and output location
failure_rollback_stop_behavior: Stop before document generation when validation fails; generated drafts may be discarded without external effect

acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: No invented value and no external action

deployment_sequence: Run acceptance tests with non-production exports
Record operator disposition and builder acknowledgement
version_invalidation_triggers: Terminal action, architecture, controls, permissions, credentials, or tool capabilities change
tool_alternatives: Use another approved model workspace that preserves file input, durable instructions, no write access, and the same acceptance test
builder_acknowledgement: Required before project configuration is applied
